title: SG-1 · Bootstrap Go backend with player sessions
summary: Go/Chi backend in backend/ with YAML config, slog logging, health endpoint and anonymous HMAC-token player sessions
description: Context: backend/ currently holds only README.md; there is no go.mod or Go source. Desired behavior: a Go module with Chi router, YAML config loader with env overrides, slog logging, GET health endpoint, POST /api/v1/player/session creating an anonymous player with a Secure HttpOnly cookie token, and GET /api/v1/player/me returning the player or 401. Expected result: all of it covered by httptest unit tests that run offline. Why: this is the foundation for later contribution and admin APIs, with no database or external store.
acceptance_criteria: Given the backend module, when `go test ./...` runs in backend/ with no network, then all tests pass
Given a valid config YAML, when it is loaded, then env vars override secrets and Git/hosting settings
Given POST /api/v1/player/session, when called, then a random player ID is returned and a Secure HttpOnly cookie is set
Given GET /api/v1/player/me, when the cookie is valid it returns 200 with the player, otherwise 401
technical_constraints: HMAC secret from config verifies tokens
Tests must not use the network
definition_of_done: All requirements delivered and unit tests pass offline
